Conversation 2 was repetitive and poorly sequenced: it asked the customer to run a test cycle before checking the condenser, then asked about heating and load (already partly answered), repeatedly asked 'run a cycle' before each new check, said 'cleaned the sensor strips again' when it was the first time, and never summarised the likely root cause or maintenance interval, making the homeowner do far more work for the same outcome.
